root_cause.text: In error paths and release functions of nvmem core, __nvmem_device_put() (which may free the nvmem structure) is called before nvmem_layout_module_put(), resulting in use-after-free when the freed nvmem structure is subsequently accessed (e.g., for checking nvmem->layout or for passing to nvmem_layout_module_put).
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves the __nvmem_device_put() call to after nvmem_layout_module_put() in of_nvmem_cell_get() (both when cell_entry is NULL and when nvmem_create_cell fails) and in nvmem_cell_put(). The CVE description confirms that the error paths free resources and then continue to use the nvmem structure.

bic_trace_step.reason: In the commit diff, the new `nvmem_layout_module_put()` function is called after `__nvmem_device_put()` in multiple places (e.g., in `of_nvmem_cell_get()`: line 1349: `__nvmem_device_put(nvmem);` then `nvmem_layout_module_put(nvmem);` at line 1350; also in error path at lines 1360-1361, and in `nvmem_cell_put()` at lines 1470-1471).
